session_dialogue.text: Hello. How are you feeling today?
I'm feeling a bit stuck again. The work just doesn't seem to be moving forward, and I keep thinking I should be further along.
That’s understandable. It’s easy to feel like you’re not making progress when things feel slow, but you’re doing the best you can.
Thanks, but I don’t feel like I’m doing enough. Every time I think I’m getting somewhere, the last part feels impossible. I end up avoiding it all together.
It sounds like you're carrying a lot of pressure on your own. Maybe it’s time to let go of the need to control everything and just take things one step at a time.
I try, but the pressure still feels too heavy. I keep thinking if I don’t finish perfectly, it’s like I’ve failed. I don’t know how to stop that thought.
That thought can be really heavy to carry alone. Let me tell you something—no one finishes perfectly, and that doesn’t mean they’ve failed.
I know, but it feels so different in my head. I keep hearing that voice saying I’m not good enough, even when I try to remind myself otherwise.
That voice is trying to control you, but it doesn’t have to be the only one you listen to. You’re stronger than that, and you’re doing better than you think.
I wish I could believe that more. Sometimes I feel like I’m fighting a battle I can’t win, and it’s exhausting.
You’re not fighting a battle you can’t win—you’re fighting a battle that’s been shaped by things you didn’t choose. And that’s okay. You don’t have to win it all at once.
It’s just so hard to remember that. I keep getting pulled back into the same patterns, like I’m stuck in a loop I can’t escape.
You’re not stuck in a loop—you’re just trying to find your way out of one that’s been around for a long time. And that’s a sign of strength, not weakness.
I guess that makes sense, but it still feels like I’m not making any real progress. I just want to feel like I can do this without falling apart.
You’re not falling apart—you’re trying to hold everything together, and that takes a lot of strength. You don’t have to do it all alone.
I know, but it’s hard to ask for help when I feel like I’m the only one who can fix this. I just want to feel like I’m enough, even if I’m not perfect.
You’re not the only one who can fix this—everyone struggles, and that’s okay. You’re already enough, just as you are.
Thanks... but I still feel like I’m not enough. It’s like no matter what I do, I’m not good enough.
You’re not the only one who feels that way, and it doesn’t mean you’re not enough. You’re already doing more than you realize.
I know, but it feels like I’m stuck in this loop of not being enough. I just want to feel like I can stop trying so hard.
